author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Upgrading your gear in Crimson Desert takes a lot of resoursces. But socketing upgrades and pushing the game takes Abyss Gears! You will find a few on your adventures and exploring but this spot on the map near hernands border with the crimson desert has a great location to farm an infinite supply of Abyss Gears! You can take these to a witch hut and convert them into random gears of different types and levels. Simply return to this location whenever you like to disarm everyone again! Have Fun With this guide!
